description: Payment capture: PaymentService.charge writes a ledger entry then confirms downstream; charge_with_retry wraps it in the generic retry helper.

defects.notes: No single line is wrong. charge appends to the ledger *before* calling the gateway, and charge_with_retry retries the whole non-idempotent operation, so a transient gateway failure leaves one ledger entry per attempt. This is the implementation_bug vs architecture_defect discrimination: the fix is a composition change (idempotency key, or ordering the write after confirmation), not a line edit. Existing tests pass because retry is only ever tested with side-effect-free callables and charge is only ever tested against a gateway that never fails.

false_positive_controls.reason: Correct in isolation: retries only TransientError, respects the attempt budget, re-raises the last error. The defect is what it is applied to, not the helper itself.
Correct. It faithfully sums ledger entries; the duplicates it would report are real, not a summing error.
